name: AMMB Holdings Berhad (AmBank Group)
oneLine: A Malaysian banking group serving individuals, businesses and corporates, with Islamic banking, investment banking and insurance.
inPlainWords: AmBank lends to households (mortgages and car loans) and to small, mid-sized and large companies, all in Malaysia.
Business banking for SMEs and mid-sized companies is its biggest profit maker.
It also earns fees from wealth products, investment banking and insurance partnerships.

flow.label: Depositors
flow.detail: Customers place savings and deposits with the bank, which pays them interest.

flow.label: The bank
flow.detail: It lends that money out as home, car, personal and business loans at a higher rate.

flow.label: Borrowers
flow.detail: Borrowers repay with interest; the gap between the two rates is the bank's main income.

flow.label: Fees
flow.detail: It also earns fees from cards, wealth products, insurance sales and transactions.

segments.name: Business Banking
segments.desc: Loans and cash management for SMEs and mid-sized companies

segments.name: Retail Banking
segments.desc: Mortgages, car loans, cards and deposits for individuals

segments.name: Transaction Banking
segments.desc: Corporate lending and payments for large companies

segmentNote: Revenue is net income (after paying depositors); profit is profit before tax by segment (Q1 FY2027 report p.28). Insurance (RM8.6m) and others (a net cost of RM65.3m) are left out.

aiImages.caption: Deposits: savers' money kept safe and paid a return
